note: Policy gap is real (no compat statement in docs/product; counts roughly hold: mobile 17, frontend 14, appwire-client 51 incl ~24 in types.gen.ts). Not purely un-approved accretion, and 'rely on ProtocolVersion mismatch' would not cover the daemon-outlives-hub case. Severity high overstated.
revised_fix_plan: Step 1: Jesse defines the skew window, explicitly including daemons that outlive a hub restart; write it as an evergreen docs/product section. Step 2: require each fallback to name its removal condition. Step 3: sweep only fallbacks older than the window; do not remove daemon-facing fallbacks (legacyTaskPublication) until the daemon-lifetime policy is settled.
